Rede now checks for updates, and can install them itself. This beta has to be downloaded by hand; from here on, Rede tells you when the next one is out.

Keep your Audiobookshelf backups: Rede writes listening progress, finished status and bookmarks to your server. Please report problems with your OS, Rede and server versions, and steps to reproduce.

### Downloads

| File | For |
| --- | --- |
| `Rede-0.1.0-beta.3-macos-universal.dmg` (or `.zip`) | macOS 11 or later, Apple silicon and Intel |
| `Rede-0.1.0-beta.3-linux-x86_64.tar.gz` | Linux on Intel/AMD, glibc 2.39 or newer |
| `Rede-0.1.0-beta.3-linux-aarch64.tar.gz` | Linux on ARM64, glibc 2.39 or newer |

On macOS, open the dmg and drag Rede to Applications. On Linux, unpack the archive and run `./install.sh`; it installs under `~/.local`. The `.minisig` files are signatures Rede checks before installing an update.

[Install and sign-in instructions](https://github.com/Solidsilver/ond/blob/rede-v0.1.0-beta.3/docs/rede/README.md).

### What's new

- Rede looks for a newer version once a day. Settings › About shows what's new and lets you check now; a notice at the foot of the sidebar says when one is out.
- Download fetches and checks an update, and Restart to Update installs it. Quitting installs it too. Install updates automatically, off by default, downloads each update when it's found and installs it the next time you quit.
- The Channel row chooses between full releases and betas. Until you choose, a beta follows betas.
- Rede installs updates itself from the macOS app in Applications and from a Linux install made with `install.sh`. Otherwise it links to the release page.

### Beta limits

- Audiobookshelf 2.26 or newer; 2.36 or newer recommended.
- One account is shown at a time; there's no merged library across accounts yet.
- Linux uses username/password sign-in. Browser/OpenID sign-in, media keys and system now-playing controls are macOS-only for now.
- Output follows the system device. No in-app output picker yet.
- Local folders, podcasts and Windows bundles come later.
